items.summary: Ensure that clicking the existing “Yes! 💕” button on the final slide reliably shows the full-screen transition overlay with visible, animated floating hearts (and the existing emojis/balloons) moving upward across the screen.

Fix the transition animation implementation so transforms that depend on CSS variables do not resolve to invalid values (e.g., provide a fallback and/or set required CSS custom properties per element) to prevent the floating animations from being dropped by the browser.

Update the lucide Heart icon rendering used for the flying hearts so size is controlled via SVG-appropriate properties (e.g., width/height or component props) rather than fontSize, ensuring the hearts render at the intended random sizes.
